children: Brazil's Conab projects corn production from the three crops of the 2026/27 cycle to total 148 million metric tons, up 2.8% from 2025/26 as planted acreage grows. Aside from rising domestic consumption driven by higher animal feed and ethanol industry use, export demand for Brazilian corn is expected to increase, potentially reaching 46 million tons in the 2026/27 cycle, Conab says. The government agency expects soybean production of 181.6 million tons for 2026/27, a small increase over the previous year. (anthony.harrup@wsj.com)
